Course description

An optional conversation at the end of Level II, like the Level I conversation but over graduate reading: historiography, primary sources and regional histories. You write a list of works with a rationale, and we talk for an hour.

Learning objectives

By the end of this course you can:

  1. Explain how the graduate works you read connect.
  2. Defend a historiographical position and answer objections.
  3. Describe how your view of Indian history changed from Level I to Level II.

Texts

  • Required: your own list of works.
